steps.title: Game created
steps.detail: Twaffle created the game and holds seat 1 while the draft waits for players.

steps.title: Table full
steps.detail: Six players are seated through the creator’s approval, and Klyzx watches as a spectator.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Twaffle picks House Atreides for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Thialfi picks House Harkonnen for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Fectumbra picks Emperor for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Erickenneth picks Spacing Guild for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Ridwan picks Fremen for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Argelius picks Bene Gesserit for the draft.

steps.title: Draft ban
steps.detail: Twaffle bans Ixians from the draft.

steps.title: Draft nearly ready
steps.detail: Five seats are ready; Argelius has not confirmed yet.

steps.title: Factions dealt
steps.detail: The deal assigned Twaffle (Fremen), Thialfi (House Atreides), Fectumbra (Spacing Guild), Erickenneth (Emperor), Ridwan (Bene Gesserit), Argelius (House Harkonnen). Trading opens.

steps.title: Trading
steps.detail: Three seats keep what they were dealt; the others are still deciding.

steps.title: Setup begins
steps.detail: Trading closed. Setup opens on Traitor selection.

steps.title: Traitors gathered
steps.detail: Twaffle combines every Traitor deck into one pile.

steps.title: Traitors shuffled
steps.detail: Twaffle shuffles the Traitor pile.

steps.title: Dealing Traitors
steps.detail: Twaffle has dealt one Traitor to every seat.

steps.title: Traitors dealt
steps.detail: Every seat holds four Traitors in hand.

steps.title: Traitor kept
steps.detail: Twaffle (Fremen) keeps one Traitor and returns three to the pile.

steps.title: Traitors kept
steps.detail: Every faction kept its Traitor, House Harkonnen all four, and confirmed Ready.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: The map is revealed and every faction places its starting forces.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) places 10 forces in Arrakeen.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) places 10 forces in Carthag.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Fectumbra (Spacing Guild) places 5 forces in Tuek's Sietch.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Twaffle (Fremen) places 4 forces in Sietch Tabr.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Twaffle (Fremen) places 3 forces in False Wall South.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Twaffle (Fremen) places 3 forces in False Wall West.

steps.title: Starting forces
steps.detail: Ridwan (Bene Gesserit) places 1 force in Polar Sink.

steps.title: Setup complete
steps.detail: Every faction has placed its forces and confirmed Ready.

steps.title: Turn 1: Storm
steps.detail: Setup ends and the first turn opens on the Storm phase.

steps.title: Storm moved
steps.detail: Twaffle moves the storm three sectors.

steps.title: Spice blow
steps.detail: The Spice blow phase opens.

steps.title: Spice card drawn
steps.detail: Twaffle draws the top Spice card into hand.

steps.title: Spice card played
steps.detail: Twaffle plays the Spice card beside the deck.

steps.title: Spice card revealed
steps.detail: Twaffle turns the Spice card face up.

steps.title: Spice from the supply
steps.detail: Twaffle takes the 8 spice the card names from the supply.

steps.title: Spice placed
steps.detail: Twaffle places 8 spice on Broken Land.

steps.title: CHOAM charity
steps.detail: The CHOAM charity phase opens.

steps.title: Bidding
steps.detail: The Bidding phase opens.

steps.title: Card won
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) wins the first Treachery card.

steps.title: Bid paid
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) pays 2 spice for it.

steps.title: Card won
steps.detail: Erickenneth (Emperor) wins the second Treachery card.

steps.title: Bid paid
steps.detail: Erickenneth (Emperor) pays 2 spice for it.

steps.title: Revival
steps.detail: The Revival phase opens.

steps.title: Shipment and movement
steps.detail: The Shipment and movement phase opens.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) ships 5 forces to Arrakeen.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.detail: Fectumbra (Spacing Guild) ships 3 forces to Imperial Basin.

steps.title: Battle
steps.detail: The Battle phase opens: House Harkonnen and House Atreides share Arrakeen.

steps.title: Battle started
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) opens a battle in Arrakeen.

steps.title: Battle side
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) takes the left side.

steps.title: Battle side
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) takes the right side.

steps.title: Battle plan
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) dials a leader and 3 spice.

steps.title: Battle plan
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) dials a leader and 2 spice.

steps.title: Battle ready
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) locks the plan.

steps.title: Battle countdown
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) locks the plan; the reveal counts down.

steps.title: Battle revealed
steps.detail: Both plans are revealed side by side.

steps.title: Battle outcome
steps.detail: Argelius (House Harkonnen) agrees House Atreides won.

steps.title: Battle resolved
steps.detail: Thialfi (House Atreides) agrees; the battle is settled.

steps.title: Spice collection
steps.detail: The Spice collection phase opens.

steps.title: Mentat pause
steps.detail: The Mentat pause ends the turn.

steps.title: Determining the winner
steps.detail: Twaffle opens the result.

steps.title: Game finished
steps.detail: Twaffle declares House Atreides the winner.
